patches.reason: Describe required explicit assistant.report permission and the child result protocol. Worker rejects delegation without a report channel before provisioning; no implicit tool grant or native-idle success.

Expose the existing Broker changeset proposal schema to the actual native model; preserve server target binding, exact approval and file CAS. Contract tests keep native/Broker artifact and format enums aligned.
Route ordinary native web_search through the tenant Tool Broker for audited bounded results and durable full-result files; keep upstream DSH unchanged.
Expose native session lifecycle and report the approved distribution version without modifying upstream packages.
Keep the DSH WebUI private executable path and required Node launch flags behind one explicit, tested compatibility boundary.
